meta.title_zh: 转币前，为什么要核对网络？
meta.source_note: Ported from pilot episode01-review-zh.md. Recovery depends on asset, network, wallet control and receiving-platform support; do not imply universal irrecoverability.

scenes.voice_zh: 发送加密资产前，先停在网络这一栏。选错网络，资产可能无法找回。
scenes.voice_en: Before you send crypto, stop at the network field. One wrong choice can leave funds out of reach.
scenes.title: 转币之前，先停一下

scenes.voice_zh: 同一种资产可能存在于不同区块链上。例如 USDT 可以通过以太坊或波场网络转移。这两条路径不能混用。
scenes.voice_en: The same asset can travel on different blockchains. For example, U S D T may be offered on Ethereum or Tron. Those routes are not interchangeable.
scenes.title: 同一种资产，不同网络
scenes.sub_en: USDT can travel on different blockchains.

scenes.voice_zh: 先打开接收平台，选择币种，查看这个账户当前支持的具体充值网络。以接收平台当前说明为准。
scenes.voice_en: Open the receiving platform first. Choose the asset, then read the exact deposit network shown for that account. Use its current instructions as your source of truth.
scenes.title: 先看接收方

scenes.voice_zh: 再回到发送平台，选择同一个网络。不要只因为手续费较低，就改选其他网络。
scenes.voice_en: Now return to the sending platform. Select that same network. A lower fee is never a reason to choose a different route.
scenes.title: 发送方选择同一网络
scenes.sub_en: Both sides must use the same network.

scenes.voice_zh: 从接收平台复制地址，粘贴到发送平台，仔细核对完整地址，包括开头和末尾字符。如果接收平台要求 Memo 或 Tag，也要填写。
scenes.voice_en: Copy the receiving address and paste it on the sending side. Compare the address carefully, including the beginning and end. If the receiver asks for a memo or tag, include that too.
scenes.title: 然后，核对完整地址
scenes.sub: 需要 Memo 或 Tag 时也要填写
scenes.sub_en: Check the pasted value before continuing.

scenes.voice_zh: 提交前复核币种、网络、地址、所需 Memo 和金额。有任何一项不明确，就暂停，并查看接收平台的官方帮助说明。
scenes.voice_en: Review the asset, network, address, any required memo, and the amount. If one item is unclear, pause and check the receiver's official help page.
scenes.title: 确认之前，复核五项

scenes.voice_zh: 先核对网络，再核对地址，最后确认。清楚核对，比快速点击更重要。
scenes.voice_en: Network first. Address next. Confirm once. That habit matters more than speed.
scenes.title: 先网络，再地址，最后确认
scenes.sub: 清楚核对，比快速点击更重要
